notes.title: Mirth Melody Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44071383/f62c49d4c50b3ccbe1b952134154ff8ef870c762.jpg[/img]

We are super excited to announce the upcoming release of our new rhythm game: [b]Mirth Melody[/b]!

[b]Mirth Melody[/b] is a small rhythm game set in the Mirth Island universe. In this game, you play as Dodo the duck, exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music.

Add Mirth Melody to your wishlist today! The game will be available in July!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721960/Mirth_Melody/]Wishlist Mirth Melody on Steam[/url]

Thank you for your support!

- Clay Game Studio
